title: smime-tree encrypt.rs: .map_err(SmimeError::Der)? is redundant where From<der::Error> exists
description: encrypt.rs and decrypt.rs: SmimeError implements From<der::Error> (via impl From<der::Error> for SmimeError in error.rs). At ~12 call sites in encrypt.rs, the code uses .map_err(SmimeError::Der)? where plain ? would suffice. This pattern is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase (decrypt.rs and verify.rs mostly use ? directly) and confuses readers into thinking the From impl is absent. Suggested rewrite: replace .map_err(SmimeError::Der)? with ? throughout.
